#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& is;
public:
    InputReader(istream& inputStream) : is(inputStream) {}

    string next() {
        string token;
        is >> token;
        return token;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
};

class TaskC {
public:
    long long sum[105];
    long long pw[105];
    bool OK;

    TaskC() : OK(false) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 105; ++i) {
            sum[i] = 0;
            pw[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        long long w = in.nextLong();
        long long m = in.nextLong();
        long long p = 1;
        int mx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
            sum[i + 1] = p + sum[i];
            pw[i] = p;
            p *= w;
            if (p > (1LL << 40)) {
                mx = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        process(0, m, mx);
        out << (OK ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    }

    void process(long long cur, long long target, int pos) {
        if (cur == target) {
            OK = true;
            return;
        }
        long long remaining = sum[pos + 1];
        long long next = pw[pos];

        if (cur - remaining > target) {
        } else if (cur + remaining < target) {
        } else {
            if (cur + sum[pos] < target) {
                process(cur + next, target, pos - 1);
            } else if (cur - sum[pos] > target) {
                process(cur - next, target, pos - 1);
            } else {
                process(cur, target, pos - 1);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    ostream& out = cout;
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
